item.title: Home Ministry mandates six-stanza Vande Mataram at state events
item.description: New protocol sets 3-minute, 10-second official version for presidential events, flag ceremonies and schools; order outlines decorum and mass singing norms

item.title: How artists are collaborating with local communities to bring about change in urban India
item.description: From a wall mural in Mapusa, Goa, to interventions in Cooke Town, Bengaluru, and events centred around a neighbourhood tamarind tree in a desperate attempt to save it, such projects show how local ownership can make a lasting impact.

item.title: White House revises India trade deal fact sheet; drops ‘pulses’ from tariff list
item.description: The revised document also softens India’s USD 500 billion purchase pledge from a 'commitment' to an 'intent' while omitting mentions of digital services taxes

item.title: Govt tightens IT rules on AI, mandates 3-hour takedown deadline
item.description: New IT Rules require social media platforms to remove illegal AI content in 3 hours and label synthetic media, effective Feb 20, 2026

item.title: Siddaramaiah ready to present record 17th Budget amid a triple challenge
item.description: An additional burden of nearly Rs 31,000 crore is set to weigh on the Karnataka government as Chief Minister Siddaramaiah prepares to present the 2026–27 Budget in the first week of March

item.title: India-US interim trade deal: Congress slams PM Modi over tariff rates
item.description: Congress criticises the India-US interim trade deal, alleging India conceded more on tariffs and questioning PM Modi’s diplomacy with President Trump

item.title: All key sensitive sectors protected under India-US Interim trade pact: Commerce Secy
item.description: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal confirms all sensitive segments are shielded under the interim deal, which is expected to be finalised by the end of March

item.title: Family of five found dead in suspected suicide case in Mathura
item.description: Five members of a family, including three children, were found dead in Mathura’s Khapparpur village. Police suspect mass suicide; note and video recovered.

item.title: Naravane book row: Delhi Police send notice to Penguin India
item.description: According to police, allegations regarding the unauthorised dissemination of the manuscript had led to the registration of an FIR and added that the matter was under investigation

item.title: Om Birla directs Lok Sabha Secretariat to correct removal notice
item.description: As many as 118 Opposition MPs file no-confidence motion against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla under Article 94C; motion likely to be taken up on March 9
